en.title: Saudi Cabinet condemns Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Cabinet condemned what it called deliberate Houthi attacks on civilian targets within the Kingdom, reaffirming the country's right to defend its sovereignty and vital interests.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's annual inflation rate stood at 1.8 percent in August 2026, driven primarily by increases in housing, utilities, and transport costs alongside modest food price rises.

en.summary: Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles and drones at civilian areas in Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Taif, resulting in 13 civilians with minor to moderate injuries and damage to seven homes and two vehicles.

en.summary: NATO fighter jets destroyed a drone that entered Lithuanian airspace, according to President Gitanas Nauseda. The Baltic nation regularly experiences drone incursions as Russia intensifies its military campaign in Ukraine.

en.summary: Yemen's Houthi militia attacked civilian areas in Saudi Arabia with ballistic missiles and drones, injuring 13 people and damaging homes and vehicles. Warning alerts were issued for multiple cities across the kingdom.

en.title: Saudi Cabinet approves National Entrepreneurship, SMEs Strategy
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Cabinet, led by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, approved a national strategy for entrepreneurship and small and medium enterprises. The Cabinet also approved additional measures including anti-money laundering committee membership for the Ministry of Investment.

en.title: Saudi Arabia's PPI rises 5.3% in July 2026
